payload.title: Riverbend School Resources
payload.text:
Riverbend School Resources
Books, library times and study ideas for Years 3 to 6.
Home Reading Library Study Tips Contact the Office
This term's reading list
The Lighthouse on Marbles Bay - a gentle adventure about two cousins and a very old map.
Nine Ways to Grow a Garden - short chapters about seeds, soil and patience.
Ravi and the Paper Rocket - a story about trying again after things go wrong.
Big Book of Small Animals - photographs and facts about creatures you can find in a park.
Moon Songs - a poetry collection to read out loud with a grown-up.
Library opening hours
Day Open Notes
Monday 8:30 - 15:45 Quiet reading corner all day
Tuesday 8:30 - 15:45 Story circle at 13:00
Wednesday 8:30 - 12:30 Shelf tidying in the afternoon
Thursday 8:30 - 16:30 Homework club until closing
Friday 8:30 - 15:00 Return your books before the weekend
Homework tips that actually help
Work for twenty minutes, then stretch for five. Repeat twice and you are done.
Read the question out loud before you start writing. It catches a lot of mistakes.
Keep one notebook for everything so nothing gets lost between subjects.
If you are stuck for more than ten minutes, ask a teacher or a grown-up at home.
Pack your bag the night before. Mornings are calmer that way.
Coming up this month
The book swap table returns on the last Thursday of the month. Bring a book you have finished and take home one you have not read yet. Ms Achebe will be in the library to help you choose.
